description.value:
Activate 1 Interact

While the elemental once imprisoned in this flask has long departed, some of its energy is still contained within, ready to be released when the flask is broken. You activate a flask of elements by removing a wax seal from the stopper. If you or anyone else hurls the flask (another Interact action), it explodes where it lands. Your toss can place the center of the explosion—a @Template[type:burst|distance:20]—anywhere within 60 feet, though at the GM's discretion, you might need to make an attack roll if the throw is unusually challenging. If no one hurls the flask by the start of your next turn, it shatters harmlessly. The effect of the explosion depends on the type of flask.

The flask explodes in a swirl of frigid air, which has the air and cold traits. Creatures within the area take @Damage[4d6[cold]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save. The ground in the area is coated with ice and becomes difficult terrain for 1 hour.
